rg-90.accroche: Ganoderma lucidum, fruiting body harvested at 90 days, in 270 mg capsules.
rg-90.description:
Reishi Gano, or RG, contains only the fruiting body of Ganoderma lucidum — the reishi mushroom — harvested at maturity, after 90 days of cultivation on a certified organic farm according to DXN. Nothing else goes into the capsule.

This bottle of 90 capsules is the middle size in the range, which also comes in 30 and 360. The directions for use are on the packaging; if you are undergoing medical treatment or are pregnant, ask a healthcare professional for advice before taking it.
rg-90.composition: 100% Ganoderma lucidum (fruiting body), 270 mg per capsule.
rg-90.usage:
Follow the directions for use printed on the bottle.
Take with a glass of water.
rg-90.points:
100% Ganoderma lucidum, fruiting body
Harvested at 90 days, on a certified organic farm according to DXN
90 capsules of 270 mg

reishi-powder.accroche: Ganoderma lucidum fruiting body and mycelium ground into a powder for mixing — the small jar.

The taste is slightly bitter, typical of the mushroom. The dose is measured with the scoop provided; details are on the packaging. This 22 g jar is the small size; the same powder comes in a 70 g jar.
reishi-powder.composition: Ganoderma lucidum fruiting body and mycelium, 100%.
reishi-powder.usage:
Mix one level measuring scoop into a glass of water or a drink.
Can also be added to a recipe.
reishi-powder.points:
100% Ganoderma lucidum: fruiting body and mycelium
Fine powder to mix into a drink
22 g jar, measured out with the scoop

From the 400 g jar, the powder is measured out with the scoop into a glass of lukewarm or cold water, preferably in a shaker: it thickens quickly, so it is best to drink it straight away.

The bottle contains 90 softgels. They are to be taken after a meal, with a glass of water, and stored in a cool, dry place. The exact EPA and DHA content is on the label; if you are on anticoagulant treatment, are pregnant or have a fish allergy, ask a healthcare professional for advice before taking it.
